requestable_evidence_items.evidence_item: Verified building area, dock count, refrigerated footprint, charging schedule, and operator boundary
requestable_evidence_items.source: Owner records, operator records, site plan, and lease summary
requestable_evidence_items.why_needed: Sets the denominator, the valid peer family, tariff interpretation, and whether value leaks across the control boundary.

pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: throughput schedule pack received or explicitly deferred
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no throughput schedule pack available from public or operator route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask operator / facility manager for operating hours and throughput windows

pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: utility bill pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no bills available through owner or operator route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask owner / accounting / operator for 12 months of bills

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: tariff sheet or bill page showing rate class
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: utility tariff pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no tariff pack available through public or operator route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask owner / accounting / operator for tariff sheet

pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: lease responsibility pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no lease matrix available through owner/operator route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask owner / asset manager / operator for lease matrix

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: meter map or explicit metering boundary confirmation
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: metering boundary pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no meter map available through owner/operator route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask owner / operator / energy manager for meter map

pack_stop_conditions.minimum_sufficient_evidence: equipment inventory covering HVAC, rooftop, and charging-relevant systems
pack_stop_conditions.stop_condition: equipment inventory pack received or explicitly unavailable
pack_stop_conditions.downgrade_condition: no equipment inventory available through maintenance route
pack_stop_conditions.escalation_condition: ask maintenance / facility engineer for equipment inventory
